outer_diameter = 80.0
inner_diameter = 30.0
collar_length = 20.0
shoulder_length = 5.0
shoulder_diameter = 60.0
thread_pitch = 2.0
thread_depth = 1.0
thread_turns = 8
thread_length = thread_pitch * thread_turns
set_screw_diameter = 5.0
set_screw_offset = 10.0
chamfer_size = 1.0
slot_width = 5.0
slot_length = 30.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, shoulder_length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (shoulder_radius, shoulder_length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (shoulder_radius, collar_length - shoulder_length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, collar_length))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (inner_radius, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5@1, (outer_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

thread_cutter = Pos(0, 0, collar_length - thread_length / 2) * Cylinder(inner_radius - thread_depth, thread_length)
solid_body = solid_body - thread_cutter

set_screw = Pos(set_screw_offset, 0, collar_length / 2) * Cylinder(set_screw_diameter / 2, collar_length)
solid_body = solid_body - set_screw

slot = Pos(outer_radius - slot_width / 2, 0, collar_length / 2) * Box(slot_width, slot_length, collar_length)
solid_body = solid_body - slot

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]

part = rod - groove_solid
